final_wiki.answer-Q-1222-A10:
Q-1222: Largest prime less than 679 is 677.

679 = 7 × 97 (not prime)
678 = even (not prime)
677 is prime: checked divisibility by 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23 (all primes up to sqrt(677)≈26.0). None divide 677.

Answer: 677
